message: `{name}` is an array; assign its elements one at a time
description: Verilog-A has no whole-array assignment: `h = g;` with `h` declared as an array is not a statement the language defines. Until 2.33.0 this was reported as an assignment to an undeclared variable.
actions: Assign each element, e.g. in a loop: `for (i = 0; i < N; i = i + 1) h[i] = g[i];`.
